The company develops, manufactures, and commercializes solutions under its own brand as well as for OEM partners. Its core expertise lies in electronic boards and software for data communication within the (Green) Energy sector. Key product domains include smart electronics for EV and solar applications, Remote Terminal Units for MV/LV substations, communication modems for metering and tokenization gateways.
